name: Garden
overview: Scripture reveals the garden as a place of divine provision and human responsibility, beginning with God planting the garden of Eden and placing man there to tend it. The garden symbolizes both blessing and loss, as seen when Adam is sent out to till the ground after departing Eden. Prophetic imagery likens God's restoration and care to a flourishing garden, promising comfort, satisfaction, and joy to His people, who will be like a watered garden sustained by His continual guidance.
